sources.source: Knife and Offensive Weapon Sentencing Statistics: 2025

sources.quality_effect: Adds criminal-justice outcome context; sentencing volumes are not incident counts, severity weights or parcel safety measurements.

sources.source: Home Office offences involving knives or sharp instruments open data

sources.quality_effect: Adds a national force-area trend and outcome cross-check without merging offence counts with outcome distributions or local proxy scores.

sources.source: Home Office offences involving firearms open data
sources.verified_fact: The official collection provides firearms offence data from year ending March 2009 onwards and separate outcomes data for April 2024 to March 2025.
sources.quality_effect: Adds a high-harm national cross-check while forbidding force-level totals from being interpreted as parcel incidence.

sources.source: Home Office transferred or cancelled crime open data
